We will compute classic: proportion of users who were active in the 90th day after signup (signup_date + 90 days).
WITH users AS (
  SELECT user_id, signup_date::date AS signup_date, user__channel
  FROM fct_users
  WHERE signup_date IS NOT NULL
),
activity AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id, active_date::date AS active_date
  FROM fct_activity
),
cohort AS (
  SELECT u.user_id, u.user__channel, u.signup_date, a.active_date,
    (a.active_date - u.signup_date) AS days_after
  FROM users u
  LEFT JOIN activity a ON a.user_id = u.user_id
),
cohort_90 AS (
  SELECT user_id, user__channel, signup_date,
    MAX(CASE WHEN days_after = 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_on_day_90
  FROM cohort
  GROUP BY user_id, user__channel, signup_date
)
SELECT user__channel AS channel,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE signup_date BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30') AS cohort_size,
  SUM(active_on_day_90) FILTER (WHERE signup_date BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30') AS retained_on_day_90,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE signup_date BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30')=0 THEN 0
       ELSE 1.0 * SUM(active_on_day_90) FILTER (WHERE signup_date BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30') / COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE signup_date BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30') END AS retention_90
FROM cohort_90
GROUP BY user__channel
ORDER BY retention_90 DESC;
